_note: A battle royale squad's systems, Season 30 where Apex publishes a number (docs/RESEARCH_PHASE_11.md section 6): the bleed-out clock per knock, a revive's 5 s and the 20 health it gives back, the banner's 90 s, a beacon's 5 s. The crawl speed, the reach and the launch pad's throw are ours.
_crawl: down, you crawl at this fraction of the crouch walk (ours)
_pad: a launch pad on a road: along it and up, m/s (ours; about 33 m along and 6.7 m up)
_ping: how long a ping lasts, s
_evo: EVO as Season 30 counts it (docs/RESEARCH_PHASE_12.md section 2.3): 1 per point of damage you deal (the levels are in items.json), 150 a knock, 100 an assist (you hurt them in the last assistWindow seconds and someone else knocked them; the window is ours), 100 a finisher, a revive 100 for the first two then 25 less each, 100 for looting a care package (once a package). Taking damage earns nothing.
_kdShield: the knockdown shield (Season 28 on): its size is your EVO level's, 200 / 450 / 750; hold fire while down to raise it; it stops what comes from the front (ours: within 70 degrees of where you face); you crawl 45% slower behind it; broken, it stays broken until your next knock
_boxRespawn: Deathbox Respawn (Season 29 on, research 2.1): hold interact 7 s at a dead squad mate's box (a tap still takes their banner); a green beam and a hum for everyone while it runs; they come back on the box with 20 health, their shield regenerating (ours: to full over 6 s), with what is left in the box. Each death adds a lockout before the next such respawn (ours: 30, 60, 120 s; Apex has not published its values), reset after 3 minutes alive.
